fusions.name: Startled Puffball
fusions.desc: Bursts spores around you, dealing 11 nature damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Kick
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 14 nature damage plus 60% more for each one, then leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fairy Ring
fusions.desc: Raises a ring of caps 4 tiles across where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Takes Root Anyway
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You gain 8% poison resistance and 6% dodge chance.
